name: tcg-card-collector
postCreateCommand: sh -c 'if ! command -v gleam >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/gleam.tar.gz https://github.com/gleam-lang/gleam/releases/download/v1.14.0/gleam-v1.14.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz && tar -xzf /tmp/gleam.tar.gz -C /tmp && sudo mv /tmp/gleam /usr/local/bin/gleam && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/gleam; fi && cd client-web && npm install'
